observations: Interactive bootstrap created the isolated synthetic administrator.
Admin invitation was captured by the local Mailpit sink.
Resending invalidated the first invitation claim.
Acceptance form fixes the invited email and removes the bearer URL.
Reader account was activated through the application service, not by submitting a new credential through browser UI.
Reader sign-in shows no administrative navigation.
Reader direct admin GET and stale admin POST display Access reserved.
A role promotion through the service was visible in the existing session; self-demotion through the UI removed admin navigation.
Deactivation and reactivation through the service did not revive the old reader session.
Known/unknown recovery requests showed identical public acknowledgement.
Reset form uses a clean URL; the application service changed the synthetic password.
Password reset revoked the existing reader session; used reset and invitation claims were rejected.
Stopping Mailpit caused an actionable invitation error; database inspection found neither an invitation nor a user for the failed delivery.
Known/unknown recovery requests showed identical transport-failure text.
Inviting an existing account returned an existing-account message.
Referrer policy corrected after WebKit Origin:null rejected auth form POSTs; logout to auth/login to login succeeded afterwards.
limitations: No browser submission of a new password during invitation acceptance or reset.
No automated domain suite added or run.
No concurrent-request or real SMTP/HTTPS delivery qualification.
File routes are authorization stubs, not real file viewers/downloads.
